new_source_record.title: Revisiting the tropical Atlantic western boundary circulation from a 25-year time series of satellite altimetry data
new_source_record.label: Dimoune et al. (2023): tropical Atlantic mean section widths
new_source_record.source_locator: Printed Table 1, page 256 (prose calls it Table 2); Sections 2.1 and 3.

new_width_records.boundary_rule: Zero crossings of signed cross-section velocity averaged over January 1993-December 2017; the half-peak strength domain is a separate operator.
new_width_records.extraction_method: Transcribed author-reported numerical section widths and definition; no figure or velocity array digitized.
new_width_records.geographic_scope: HS2 / rNBC2: source-specific regional branch or retroflection zone; not a uniform whole-current width.
new_width_records.layer: Altimetry-derived surface geostrophic field; no fixed-depth bounds inferred.
new_width_records.name: North Brazil Current
new_width_records.range_interpretation: Published approximate mean-field oblique section width; no error interval. Regional sections do not establish annual or seasonal extrema.
remaining_gates: Independent scientific admission and native/WASM/UI delivery remain pending.
Recover source section endpoints and paired mean velocity edges before physical geometry or state intersections.
Annual extrema, numerical uncertainty and whole-current representativeness remain unknown.
Retain and resolve source discrepancy; do not convert it into a range.
new_width_records.section_orientation: Source rotated section component: 45 degrees; exact endpoints and paired edge coordinates not extracted.
new_width_records.source_citation: Dimoune et al. (2023), Ocean Science 19, 251-268, doi:10.5194/os-19-251-2023.
new_width_records.source_locator: Printed Table 1, page 256 (called Table 2 in prose); Sections 2.1 and 3.
new_width_records.source_quality_note: Author-reported approximate width of mean surface geostrophic section profile; 0.25-degree product omits ageostrophic flow. Unknown paired geometry, product release version and numerical uncertainty are retained.
new_width_records.time_convention: January 1993–December 2017 mean velocity-profile context; width of mean field, not mean instantaneous width or seasonal range.
